title: The Beacon That Answered Itself
central_conflict: the harbor watch received a reply to its distress signal from an empty island
decisive_choice: a repeater left in test mode was rebroadcasting the original signal after a delay
resolution: reset the repeater and verified messages with the island station
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the harbor watch received a reply to its distress signal from an empty island during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they replaced the radio antenna but the reply persisted; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a repeater left in test mode was rebroadcasting the original signal after a delay; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they reset the repeater and verified messages with the island station, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
